'''Brooks Carlson''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] along with another Imperial, [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]]. Carlson was hired as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] for [[General/Legends|General]] Madine's [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel commando unit]], and also trained [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Dansra Beezer]] to serve in that profession. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Alliance decided to [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack]] the Empire's [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. Carlson, by then a veteran scout and [[Pathfinders/Legends|pathfinder]] with the [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], was part of a [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] sent to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] to deactivate the [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|SLD-26 planetary shield generator]] protecting the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. The strike team managed to disable the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], allowing Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to destroy the Death Star.

==Biography==
===Service and defection from the Empire===
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] Brooks Carlson lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CCG" /> Originally a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="CSWE" /> Carlson defected to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] along with<ref name="CCG" /> the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]] leader<ref name="Madine DB">{{DB|character|generalcrixmadine|Madine, General Crix}}</ref>&mdash;and later Rebel [[General/Legends|general]]&mdash;[[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]]. Carlson was hired as a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] for Madine's [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]].<ref name="CCG" /> At some point during the war, Carlson trained [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Dansra Beezer]] to also serve as a scout in the Alliance commandos.<ref name="CCG2">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Corporal Beezer}}</ref>

===Service in Han Solo's strike team===
By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|44|END 11-14|The Battle of Endor}}</ref> Carlson had attained the [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]].<ref name="CCG" /> During that year,<ref name="FF" /> the Alliance discovered that the Empire was constructing a [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. The Alliance decided to [[Battle of Endor/Legends|attack]] the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] while it was still in construction; however, in order to destroy the [[Space station/Legends|station]], the Alliance first had to deactivate the [[SLD-26 planetary shield generator/Legends|SLD-26 planetary shield generator]] on Endor protecting the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="RotJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> A [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team]] was organized by General [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to infiltrate the [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="mts">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> Carlson, by then a veteran scout<ref name="FF" /> and [[Pathfinders/Legends|pathfinder]], joined the team.<ref name="CSWE" />

Carlson<ref name="FF" /> and the rest of the strike team traveled to the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] aboard the stolen Imperial [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']], [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by Solo. Queried by the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] in defensive orbit over Endor, Solo gave a stolen Imperial code, and the ''Executor'' provided the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] clearance to land on the Forest Moon. Shortly after landing on the moon's surface, the strike team waited while Solo and the team's command crew&mdash;[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]&mdash;scouted the area ahead to make sure it was clear. In the process, Solo alerted a [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] patrol to the strike team's presence, resulting in a [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] chase between Skywalker, Organa, and several of the Imperial scouts.<ref name="RotJ" />

Carlson<ref name="FF" /> and the rest of the squad waited until only Skywalker returned. When it became evident that Organa was missing, Solo took the rest of the command crew to search for her, ordering the squad to continue on and to rendezvous at the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] at 0300 [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].<ref name="RotJ" /> [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]], the strike team's [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], led the squad toward the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] generator. Several times along the way, the squad encountered Imperial patrols and managed to hide. However, Corporal [[Delevar]], the team's [[Medic/Legends|medic]], almost compromised their position by preparing to take a potshot at a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]]; he was consequently stopped and reprimanded by Derlin.<ref name="Night Attack">{{WEGCite|story=Night Attack|book=Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi}}</ref>

When night fell,<ref name="Night Attack" /> Carlson<ref name="CCG" /> and the squad made camp in a camouflaged shallow ravine, posting two sentries and setting up a [[blanket grid]] with their [[Scanner|scanning equipment]]. Shortly after their first [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]] shift, the scanners detected an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] moving toward their location. Corporal Beezer and another member of the squad, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Greeve (Human)|Greeve]], [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] the walker's transmissions and destroyed its spotlights with a [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]], respectively, and the squad circled the walker in order to keep it off balance. Delevar fired a [[Smoke canister/Legends|smoke canister]] into the AT-ST's [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] [[Window/Legends|window]] when it began firing randomly into the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and foliage. The resulting smoke explosion forced the walker's crew to abandon the vehicle and surrender to the strike team. The squad captured the Imperials and forced the walker pilot to make a comm check-in at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]]. The squad continued on to the rendezvous point, forcing the walker pilot to make several more check-ins on the way to explain the scout walker's absence.<ref name="Night Attack" />

[[File:Ds2destroyed.png|thumb|left|250px|The strike team's destruction of the deflector shield enabled Rebel starfighters to destroy the second Death Star itself.]]
Solo and the others then rejoined the rest of their group, having allied themselves with the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] tribe of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], who showed the Rebel commandos a route to the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker's]] backdoor.<ref name="RotJ" /> Carlson<ref name="CCG" /> and the rest of the commandos proceeded into the bunker; however, they were soon ambushed by [[Tempest Force/Legends|Tempest Force]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] [[Legion/Legends|legion]] stationed on the moon, and the entire strike team was captured and led outside the bunker. Their capture proved to be brief, however, as the Ewoks attacked the Imperial [[Troop/Legends|troops]], turning the tide of the battle in favor of the Rebel Alliance. The Rebel commandos successfully destroyed the shield generator<ref name="RotJ" /> with the use of [[7-PrG proton grenade/Legends|7-PrG proton grenades]].<ref name="EG">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> With the Death Star's [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] destroyed, Alliance [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were able to destroy the Imperial [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].<ref name="RotJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Brooks Carlson had fair skin. His [[Hair/Legends|hair]] was gray<ref name="CCG" /> in 4 ABY. Carlson was a veteran scout<ref name="FF" /> and pathfinder by the time of the Battle of Endor.<ref name="CCG" />

==Equipment==
During his service with the Endor strike team, Carlson wore the forest camouflage [[Uniform|gear]] of the team's members.<ref name="CCG" /> He was armed with an [[A280 blaster rifle/Legends|A280 blaster rifle]].<ref name="Starships image">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 7|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 7]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Strike_Team_promo.jpg|thumb|right|250px|One of the promotional photos of Carlson and other strike team members, shown standing in the Death Star with Luke Skywalker]]
Although he appeared in promotional photos of [[1983]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> Brooks Carlson did not appear in the final film.<ref name="RotJ" /> The photos, displayed in the [[1998]] ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' CD-ROM, show Carlson, along with other Rebel commandos, standing in the second Death Star along with Luke Skywalker and the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="BtM" /> Although uncredited, stuntman [[Alf Joint]] portrayed the character.<ref name="Aficionado">{{Blogspot|subdomain=starwarsaficionado|url=2010/09/classic-image-rebel-assembly.html|name=Star Wars Aficionado|text=CLASSIC IMAGE: REBEL ASSEMBLY!}}</ref> Carlson was first brought into [[canon]], and given a name and backstory, on a card for the [[June]] [[1999]] ''[[Endor Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]],<ref name="CCG" /> with the name simultaneously being used on a separate card for Corporal Dansra Beezer.<ref name="CCG2" />

In his blog on [[StarWars.com]], [[Lucasfilm]] [[Holocron continuity database]] keeper [[Leland Chee]] speculated that Decipher used pictures of the same actor to represent Sergeant Brooks Carlson and Corporal Delevar.<ref name="Chee blog">{{Blog|holocron|26|General Solo's Rebel strike team}}</ref>
